game_title: Return Or Print – Aurora Terrace Streak
game_concept: A card battler set in Snowy Hold – Aurora Terrace, a terrace under the aurora: the snow ranger must handle snow wraiths while practicing functions. Core idea – Return Or Print: Decide whether to return or print and see why only return passes data on.
theme: Snowy Hold – Aurora Terrace: a terrace under the aurora
core_gameplay_loop: In Aurora Terrace, repeat each round: Decide whether to return or print and see why only return passes data on. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the court_score value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 9 consecutive correct decisions about court_score to power up the snow ranger and open the larder door.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 1 (intro tier): Return Or Print
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how court_score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against snow wraiths in Aurora Terrace.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 9.
